name: app-dark-thanks-for-watching-fading-caps-slide
title: Thanks for Watching in Fading Caps
whatItIs: A near-black slide with giant caps 'THANKS FOR WATCHING!' fading from bright silver to nearly invisible, a blue tilted Follow pill, four category labels, a short paragraph and two contact fields boxed in blue.
whatItMeans: The fading letters create drama and depth, and the blue pill and contact boxes give clear next steps.
techniques: Gradient fade across giant uppercase letters
Tilted blue Follow pill overlapping the type
Contact info in blue-boxed fields with corner marks
Slash-prefixed service labels across the top

vocabulary.definition: Lettering that loses opacity across its width.
Small marks at the corners of a boxed field.
A short tag naming an offered service.
